summary: CADINSAN 2025: insegurança alimentar entre famílias do CadÚnico, com e sem o Bolsa Família, por município.

fields.name: codigoIbge
fields.description: 7-digit IBGE code; joins to `feature.properties.codarea` on the map.

fields.name: municipio
fields.description: Município name (for display), from the CADINSAN source.

fields.name: uf
fields.description: State (UF) full name, from the CADINSAN source.

fields.name: regiao
fields.description: Macro-region, from the CADINSAN source.

fields.name: absolutoComPbf
fields.description: Food-insecure CadÚnico families including PBF beneficiaries.

fields.name: absolutoSemPbf
fields.description: Food-insecure CadÚnico families excluding PBF beneficiaries.

fields.name: cadastrosCadunico
fields.description: Total CadÚnico registrations in the município (the share denominator).

fields.name: proporcaoComPbf
fields.description: Share (%) of CadÚnico families in food insecurity including PBF: `(absolutoComPbf / cadastrosCadunico) * 100`, rounded to two decimals, or `null` when `cadastrosCadunico` is `0` (no denominator).

fields.name: proporcaoSemPbf
fields.description: Share (%) of CadÚnico families in food insecurity excluding PBF: `(absolutoSemPbf / cadastrosCadunico) * 100`, rounded to two decimals, or `null` when `cadastrosCadunico` is `0` (no denominator).

usage: Coroplético de insegurança alimentar (join geometryId: codigoIbge).
constraints: As proporções são 0–1: exiba como rampa, nunca coroplético dos totais absolutos.

summary: Grade de hexágonos H3 cobrindo o Brasil, cada célula com a contagem de CAFs.

parameters.name: r
parameters.description: Resolução H3 (0–15). Padrão: 5. Valor inválido cai na resolução padrão, sem 404.

fields.name: features[].geometry.coordinates
fields.description: A single closed ring, GeoJSON order (`[longitude, latitude]`). Six or eight vertices — H3 adds vertices where a cell crosses an icosahedron edge.

fields.name: features[].properties.h3
fields.description: H3 index of the cell. Doubles as the map's join key (`joinKey: 'h3'`), which is what promotes it to the MapLibre feature id: a string cannot be carried in the feature's own `id`, because geojson is serialised through the vector-tile encoder and that spec allows only integer ids.

fields.name: features[].properties.count
fields.description: CAFs whose principal property falls in the cell. `0` is a real answer — the grid covers the whole territory, so an empty cell is a fact about it rather than missing data.

usage: Agregação hexagonal de CAFs (join joinKey: h3).

summary: Um ponto por UF, posicionado no centroide ponderado dos CAFs.

fields.name: features[].geometry.coordinates
fields.description: GeoJSON order: `[longitude, latitude]`. The CAF-weighted centroid.

fields.name: features[].properties.nome
fields.description: Full state name, e.g. `Bahia`. Doubles as the map's join key (`joinKey: 'nome'`), so the hover card can title itself from `MapHoverInfo.featureId` without the app carrying a sigla→name table. Brazilian state names are stable and unique, which is what makes them usable as an identity.

fields.name: features[].properties.quantidade
fields.description: CAFs in the UF: the sum over every município whose IBGE code it prefixes.

usage: Nível país do zoom hierárquico de CAFs (join joinKey: nome).

summary: Contagem de CAFs (Cadastro Nacional da Agricultura Familiar) e percentual do Brasil por município.

fields.name: codigoIbge
fields.description: 7-digit IBGE code; joins to `feature.properties.codarea` on the map.

fields.name: municipio
fields.description: Município name (for display); taken from the CAF source records.

fields.name: quantidade
fields.description: Number of distinct CAFs (`nr_caf`) counted in this município.

fields.name: percentualDoBrasil
fields.description: Share of all Brazilian CAFs counted in this município: `(quantidade / totalBrasil) * 100`, rounded to six decimals (CAF shares are tiny; see `cafsPercentualDoBrasil` in `toCafsPorMunicipio.ts`), where `totalBrasil` is the sum of `quantidade` across every município (the national total the choropleth paints). Always a number (never `null`) because every row has `quantidade >= 1`; `0` only in the degenerate case of no CAFs at all.

usage: Coroplético de distribuição de CAFs (join geometryId: codigoIbge).

summary: Contagem de cozinhas agregada por município.

parameters.name: ano
parameters.description: Ano do snapshot, no formato YYYY. Padrão: ano mais recente disponível.

fields.name: codigoIbge
fields.description: 7-digit IBGE code; joins to `feature.properties.codarea` on the map.

fields.name: municipio
fields.description: Município name (for display); taken from the source records.

fields.name: quantidade
fields.description: Number of cozinhas located inside this município's polygon, plus those whose point falls outside every polygon and that declare this município's IBGE code (a polygon match always wins over the declared code).

fields.name: pessoasAtendidas
fields.description: Total people served, summed from each cozinha's free-text `publicoTotalAtendido` in this município. Only cozinhas with a parseable count contribute to the sum; `null` when none of the município's cozinhas report a parseable count (unknown, never coerced to `0`).

fields.name: populacao
fields.description: Município resident population (IBGE Census 2022). `null` when the município has no entry in the population snapshot (no valid rate denominator).

fields.name: porCemMil
fields.description: Cozinhas per 100,000 inhabitants: `(quantidade / populacao) * 100_000`, rounded to two decimals. `null` when `populacao` is unknown, so the rate choropleth treats the município as "sem dado".

fields.name: percentualDoBrasil
fields.description: Share of all Brazilian cozinhas located in this município: `(quantidade / totalBrasil) * 100`, rounded to two decimals, where `totalBrasil` is the sum of `quantidade` across every município (the national total the choropleth paints). Always a number (never `null`) because every row has `quantidade >= 1`; `0` only in the degenerate case of no cozinhas at all.

fields.name: pessoasCadUnico
fields.description: People registered in the Cadastro Único in this município (MDS/SAGI MI Social, reference month 2026-06). `null` when the município has no entry in the CadÚnico snapshot (no valid rate denominator).

fields.name: porDezMilCadUnico
fields.description: Cozinhas per 10,000 people registered in the Cadastro Único: `(quantidade / pessoasCadUnico) * 10_000`, rounded to two decimals. `null` when `pessoasCadUnico` is unknown, so the CadÚnico choropleth treats the município as "sem dado". Measures coverage of the vulnerable population the cozinhas serve, rather than density over the whole population.

fields.name: pessoasPorCozinha
fields.description: People registered in the Cadastro Único per cozinha — the inverse coverage ratio `pessoasCadUnico / quantidade`, rounded to a whole person (higher = each cozinha serves more people = thinner coverage). `null` when `pessoasCadUnico` is unknown, so the coverage choropleth treats the município as "sem dado".

usage: Dados para coroplético de cozinhas por município (join geometryId: codigoIbge).
constraints: Nunca use o dataset cozinhas_pessoas_atendidas em modo coroplético (retorna 422): é um total absoluto, não uma taxa.

summary: Índice de Vulnerabilidade Social (Atlas da Vulnerabilidade Social, IPEA) por município.

fields.name: codigoIbge
fields.description: 7-digit IBGE code; joins to `feature.properties.codarea` on the map.

fields.name: municipio
fields.description: Município name (for display); taken from the source records.

fields.name: ivs
fields.description: Overall IVS score, `0`–`1` (Atlas da Vulnerabilidade Social, IPEA, 2010). Higher = more vulnerable. Always present and within `[0, 1]` — the transformer drops rows where this or any sub-index is out of range or missing.

fields.name: ivsInfraestruturaUrbana
fields.description: IVS Infraestrutura Urbana sub-index, `0`–`1`; higher = more vulnerable.

fields.name: ivsCapitalHumano
fields.description: IVS Capital Humano sub-index, `0`–`1`; higher = more vulnerable.

fields.name: ivsRendaETrabalho
fields.description: IVS Renda e Trabalho sub-index, `0`–`1`; higher = more vulnerable.

fields.name: idhm
fields.description: Overall Municipal Human Development Index (IDHM), `0`–`1`; higher = better.

fields.name: idhmLongevidade
fields.description: IDHM Longevidade dimension, `0`–`1`; higher = better.

fields.name: idhmEducacao
fields.description: IDHM Educação dimension, `0`–`1`; higher = better.

fields.name: idhmRenda
fields.description: IDHM Renda dimension, `0`–`1`; higher = better.

fields.name: idhmEducacaoEscolaridade
fields.description: IDHM Educação escolaridade sub-component, `0`–`1`; higher = better.

fields.name: idhmEducacaoFrequencia
fields.description: IDHM Educação frequência escolar sub-component, `0`–`1`; higher = better.

usage: Coroplético de vulnerabilidade social (join geometryId: codigoIbge).
constraints: É um índice ordinal (0–1): exiba como rampa/intervalos, nunca como bolhas.
